name: CozyFluffyFit
summary: This VR app offers games set in a cozy and adorable space where you can engage in activities that involve moving your body. You can put sweets into boxes, catch falling cat plushies, and more. In the game where you put sweets into boxes, you can grab the sweets using the trigger button on the controller and toss them towards the boxes, making it a simple and enjoyable experience. Similarly, in the game where you catch falling cat plushies, you just need to touch the controller to the plushies to catch them,
